description: Java class implementing a Freemarker TemplateTransformModel for rendering content as text, with support for editing and XML escaping.

classes.name: RenderContentTransform
classes.description: Implements a Freemarker TemplateTransformModel to render content as text with optional editing features.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer that renders content as text, handling XML escaping and optional editing UI.

methods.name: renderSubContent
methods.description: Renders the main or sub content based on provided arguments, with error handling.

methods.name: openEditWrap
methods.description: Wraps content in a div with a specified edit style.

methods.name: closeEditWrap
methods.description: Closes the edit wrapper by adding an 'Edit' link.

methods.name: getEditStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the style for the edit wrapper, defaulting to 'buttontext'.
